rule: non-neutral class (6-class group of the top label/emotion) if its score > t, else neutral
primary: raw_max_sigmoid: max raw GoEmotions sigmoid over the 27 non-neutral labels (weighted)
secondary: pct_max_percentile: max go_pct_* over the 8 emotions. Percentiles are ranks, so the neutral share is largely fixed by construction (about P(max of 8 correlated ranks <= t)); this view also cannot produce sadness (none of the 8 emotions maps to it)
